entries.value: CRITICAL ENERGY FAILURE — reserve below {{threshold}} kWh. Clean panels to restore generation and recharge the reserve.
A broom is available at the solar park entrance.
Broom equipped. Enter the outline of a dusty panel.
Panel {{n}} is clean. Look for panels slightly lightened by sand.
Panel {{n}}: hold the left mouse button for {{seconds}} s to clean.

Dust builds up on the 32 panels over time. Pick up the broom with E at the park entrance, enter a panel outline and hold the left mouse button. The reserve supports the base for a while; below 100 kWh, an alert requests maintenance. Cleaning restores generation and the reserve recharges gradually.
Hold Shift while moving to run. Release Shift to walk again.
